product.name: ChronoQuest Time Travel Board Game
product.description: ChronoQuest Time Travel Board Game invites players on a journey through eras, combining strategy, memory, and teamwork. The 60 cm by 40 cm board features a map of key historical milestones, while 1000 interlocking puzzle pieces form the game’s dynamic path. Players collect time tokens, answer trivia, and negotiate alliances to reach the final epoch. Designed for 2–4 players, ages 10 and up, the game offers replayability through variable card decks and modular board tiles. The set includes a rulebook, score markers, and a storage box, making it suitable for family game nights and educational settings alike.
